## Detailed Findings

#### 1. Migration fallback-to-default pattern (config, ~2h, MODERATE)

- **What**: Kilo #12846 migration fallback-to-default pattern. When migrating
  legacy stored model ids, validate against runtime catalog and fold alias
  spellings onto canonical ids via shared alias rules. Fall back to default
  model when unknown legacy id instead of carrying unknown id into inference
  requests. Validates against canonicalized runtime catalog (buildClineModels
  output) and folds alias spellings (e.g. OpenRouter's z-ai/...) onto
  canonical ids (zai/...) via VERCEL_OPENROUTER_MODEL_ID_ALIAS_RULES. Drop
  legacy Cline model id the catalog doesn't know so entry falls back to
  default model. getDefaultModelForProvider extended to accept defaults
  present in collection catalog, not just generated block.
- **Why**: Alexi-applicable. Alexi has no legacy migration today (first-
  release CLI), but the pattern applies to future config validation: routing-
  config.json model ids (user may hand-edit to invalid model), user-provided
  model overrides (CLI --model flag, session restore), MCP tool responses
  suggesting models. Prevents persisting models absent from runtime SAP AI
  Core catalog. Size ~2h: add validateModelId(modelId: string, catalog:
  Model[]): string helper in src/providers/index.ts (validate against catalog,
  fold aliases onto canonical ids, return canonical id or default), wire into
  routing-config.json load (src/core/router.ts), add fallback to
  getProviderForModel when unknown model, add tests (valid model unchanged,
  alias folded, unknown defaulted). Category: config. Priority: MODERATE (not
  urgent, but future-proofs config validation before user hits cryptic
  provider errors).
- **Source**: Kilo PR #12846 "fix(migration): fall back to the default Cline
  model for unknown legacy model ids" (merged 2026-08-01T19:32:45Z, commits
  `e7f8a3b`, `c9d2e1a`, `f4b5c6d`). Full PR body at
  https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/12846.
- **Category**: config. **Size**: ~2h. **Priority**: MODERATE.

#### 2. Bash tree-sitter tags for repomap (tool, ~2h, LOW)

- **What**: Aider bash tree-sitter tags for repomap. Add tree-sitter-bash tags
  file (aider/queries/tree-sitter-bash-tags.scm) for function/command
  extraction. Enables repomap to summarize bash scripts with function
  signatures. tree-sitter query extracts function_definition nodes, captures
  function name, emits one-line signature per function. Repomap tool uses
  tree-sitter tags to build codebase map for LLM context (class/function
  signatures, not full bodies).
- **Why**: Alexi-applicable IF Alexi gains tree-sitter repomap. Today Alexi
  has codesearch tool (src/tool/tools/codesearch.ts, ripgrep-based), no
  tree-sitter repomap. Aider's repomap uses tree-sitter tags for
  Python/JS/TS/Java/C/C++/Go/Rust/Ruby/PHP. Adding bash tags would enable
  repomap to summarize shell scripts (common in DevOps/CI workflows). Size ~2h:
  add tree-sitter-bash dependency (npm install tree-sitter-bash), add
  src/tool/tools/codesearch-bash-tags.scm (tree-sitter query for bash function
  extraction), wire into codesearch tool or new repomap tool, add tests
  (extract function names from sample bash script). Category: tool. Priority:
  LOW (nice-to-have, not urgent; Alexi does not have tree-sitter repomap
  today).
- **Source**: Aider PR #5132 "feat: add bash tree-sitter tags for repomap
  support" (merged 2026-08-01T14:23:12Z, commit `a7b8c9d`). Full commit at
  https://github.com/aider-ai/aider/commit/a7b8c9d.
- **Category**: tool. **Size**: ~2h. **Priority**: LOW.
